title: Judgment on Assyria

questions.question: Woe to those who decree iniquitous decrees, and the writers who keep writing what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 10:1 (ESV): "and the writers who keep writing oppression,"

questions.question: Ah, Assyria, the rod of my what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 10:5 (ESV): "Ah, Assyria, the rod of my anger;"

questions.question: Shall the axe boast over him who hews with it, or the saw magnify itself against him who wields it?
A remnant will return, the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty what?
For the LORD God of hosts will make a full end, as decreed, in the midst of all the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 10:23 (ESV): "in the midst of all the earth."

questions.question: To turn aside the needy from justice and to rob the poor of my people of their what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 10:2 (ESV): "and to rob the poor of my people of their right,"

questions.question: Against a godless nation I send him, and against the people of my wrath I command him, to take spoil and seize what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 10:6 (ESV): "to take spoil and seize plunder,"

questions.question: But he does not so intend, and his heart does not so think; but it is in his heart to do what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 10:7 (ESV): "but it is in his heart to destroy,"

questions.question: For he says: "Are not my commanders all what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 10:8 (ESV): "Are not my commanders all kings?"

questions.question: Therefore the Lord GOD of hosts will send wasting sickness among his stout what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 10:16 (ESV): "will send wasting sickness among his stout warriors,"

questions.question: The light of Israel will become a fire, and his Holy One a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 10:17 (ESV): "and his Holy One a flame,"

questions.question: And the yoke will be broken because of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 10:27 (ESV): "and the yoke will be broken because of the fat." (Some translations say "anointing", ESV says "fat").

questions.question: He has come to Aiath; he has passed through Migron; at Michmash he stores his what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 10:28 (ESV): "at Michmash he stores his baggage;"

questions.question: This very day he will halt at Nob; he will shake his fist at the mount of the daughter of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 10:32 (ESV): "at the mount of the daughter of Zion,"

questions.question: The great in height will be hewn down, and the lofty will be brought what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 10:33 (ESV): "and the lofty will be brought low."

key_verse_text: In that day the remnant of Israel and the survivors of the house of Jacob will no more lean on him who struck them, but will lean on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
